hooks.text: 像FreeCell一样拖动技能与物品卡，并在库存中暂存两张牌优化顺序
hooks.excerpt: Optimize every choice: whether to keep or discard skill cards and item cards is entirely up to you. Drag cards like you would in FreeCell, and even store two cards in your inventory.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次翻牌可能出现精英敌人、救命道具或装备宝箱，战斗也可主动回避
hooks.excerpt: In this enthralling adventure, you'll face various kinds of enemies. Will you bravely engage in combat or wisely avoid fights? Collect equipment and items from chests, or discard them? Your decisions shape your fate - to win or to perish, it's all in your hands. Exploring this unknown world means never knowing what the next card will reveal. It could be an elite enemy, a life-saving item, or a prize chest filled with fancy equipment. Every flip brings a new challenge or opportunity!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 100余件装备支持超高防御铁壁或一击玻璃炮等极端路线
hooks.excerpt: Build your loadout from over 100 pieces of equipment and items across different characters. Experience a wide range of playstyles in this endless adventure: become an impenetrable wall with ultra-high defense, or a one-hit wonder glass cannon with devastating attacks.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
